biography.plain_text: The Government of the Philippines is the executive administration of the Republic of the Philippines. Through executive departments, agencies and public information bodies, it implements legislation, manages national policy and provides government services. The name refers to the administration collectively as a public institution, not the president, a cabinet secretary or any other individual officeholder.

long_biography.plain_text:
The Philippine national government administers the executive functions of the Republic through departments, agencies and other public bodies. These institutions implement legislation, coordinate national programmes and deliver services across the policy areas assigned to them.

Public information agencies form part of that wider structure by communicating government programmes and official developments to citizens. Presidents, cabinet secretaries and agency leaders serve within the administration, but the government continues beyond any individual term across successive administrations. The name represents that enduring national institution collectively and not a particular elected or appointed official.
